criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Ten words in huge Archivo, and the hook unit is new: 'More than three Alaskas of power, planned for Prudhoe Bay.' It is honest because 10,000/3,106.5 = 3.22 (C46). At the 432px thumb it reads as one big rotor on pale snow. It falls short of 9 for two reasons. The art could be any turbine on any snow, and only the word 'Prudhoe' makes it Alaskan. 'Three Alaskas of power' also takes a beat to parse as a unit.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: 02 pays off the cover right away with counted bores (31/30/100, asserted by qa). 06 to 07 to 08 is a strong money, shut terms, ask run with the blind closed and then open. The middle is still loose. The flow critic rated the 02-03, 03-04, 04-05 and 05-06 pulls weak. 04 (fuel, two unreconciled counts, CERAWeek) is the most reorderable beat even after its round-4 trim. Slide 07's headline 'The terms aren't public.' is repeated almost word for word by its last body sentence, 'The financial structure is not public.'

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: The craft cycle produced real but marginal gains, none moving the deck-level judgment. 02 gained a darker lower crescent and deeper bore per ring but still reads as 161 identical icons on a pale field. 04's handwheels are spoked and the bodies a touch lighter, but the tree is still a near-black stack of ruled cylinders and the snow strokes read as water. 08's paddle gained a lit rim arc and less blur but still reads as a dark wedge at thumb. 05 and 01 were reverted and are unchanged: 05's smeared jacket blotches and floating fins, 01's unlit pedestals and featureless pad. 03 remains the best frame and 06's stake is well modelled. Five frames still carry named defects, so the honest score stays 7.0.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: The data is in the art. 02 is one bore per 100 MW, counted by the frame. 03 is puck area proportional to EIA installed MW, with the Prudhoe disc at 3,000 MW and the ring at 10,000 MW (ring/disc radius about 1.86, close to sqrt(3.33)). 06's band heights are linear in dollars (48 and 200 px, two declared scales). The literal anchors match the beats: turbine rotor, wellhead tree, VSM line with thermosiphon beside 'N/A', and the spectacle blind closed for 'not public' and open for the ask. Gold means only the public's money. A stranger would guess Slope gas power. The fog keyed to sourcing is invisible to a reader, which keeps this from a 9.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: Named throughout: Prudhoe Bay, the North Slope Borough, its seven village plants at 21.4 MW (C44), all 152 Alaska plants on a real DEM, VSMs with thermosiphon radiators (an authentically Slope detail), the Alaska Current, Dermot Cole, and real coordinates. The one imported beat is CERAWeek in Texas. No person is named, deliberately, because of the election.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Every content slide adds a new specific: 3,106.5 MW and 152 plants (02), TFC and the 21.4 MW village plants (03), 30 vs 35 tcf plus EIA's main fuel (04), the proposal's N/A (05), $1.2M and $5M (06), and the resolution's words plus 'initially' (07). Thin or repeated spots: 04 opens with 'Two outlets, two areas, two counts' and repeats 'already' from its headline, and 07 says 'not public' twice.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: Hero (THE PAD LOG), atmosphere, hook, palette and continuity devices are all new against the ledger windows. Reused subsystems: the 'one modelled object per frame, one place, one fixed light' template is the third in four decks (No.74 long table, No.75 inspection bench). Mark-making repeats the same toolkit: 112 lathe ring engraving, 120 averaged overcast raymarch, bas-relief, PBR. Archivo condensed display returns from No.74/70. Survey stake with flagging returns from No.71. The topic lane, data-center power, is the sixth in about 30 days (68, 70, 71, 74, 76).

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: Floors met. Counters on all eight frames, vector PDF 7.74 MB titled 'More Than Three Alaskas of Power, Planned for Prudhoe Bay'. All headlines and bodies read at 432px. Squeakers: on 01, alaskaaihq.com sits on the dark near pedestal and snow edge. 03's smallest pucks and footer slug are faint at thumb (decorative).

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: The hook is the first 132 chars, a cold number, and the caption is 851 chars. It takes a position ('It should be, before a plant this size goes up.'), has a deck-summary line, and closes on a debatable question ('what is the strongest case for keeping the terms private?'). Attribution is careful and the like-for-like nameplate basis is honest. Soft spot: the deck-summary line describes the art ('sits in fog', 'closed pipe blind') rather than adding a point.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: copy.json has the post, exactly 3 hashtags, a first-comment source block with primary EIA queries first, the document title, aftercare (including the October 6th election caution) and editor notes. assemble shows 8 thumbs, contact sheet and verified source hashes. Not yet a finished deliverable: gate_status shows site_fresh FAIL (docs/ not rebuilt) and ship_gate pending this score, and the Gmail draft, URLs and merge are not yet verifiable.
